title: Han Solo
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: Han Solo grew up on the Inner rim planet of Corellia. Around the same time Solo became a smuggler, he also won his ship, the Millennium Falcon off to his pal Lando Calrissian in a game of Sabacc. Some years later, while fleeing the forces of the Empire, Solo sought out Calrissian to help repair that very same ship. Solo walked into a trap, orchestrated by a conflicted Calrissian at the behest of Darth Vader, who sought to use the smuggler as bait for his true prey, Luke Skywalker.
